phrases.english: Your call lands, my worry drifts away.
phrases.norwegian: Når du ringer, flyr bekymringen min.

phrases.english: We swap snacks, share stories, forget stress.
phrases.norwegian: Vi deler snacks, forteller historier, glemmer stress.

phrases.english: Breathe out, loosen your shoulders, soften your gaze
phrases.norwegian: Pust ut, slipp skuldrene, mykblikk

phrases.english: In quiet, let the day drift past you
phrases.norwegian: I stillhet, la dagen gli forbi

phrases.english: Pause now, hear the room, then smile
phrases.norwegian: Stans nå, lytt i rommet, smil

phrases.english: Let thoughts pass, like clouds, without chasing
phrases.norwegian: La tanker fly, som skyer, uten å jakte

phrases.english: Your breath is a clock, tick gently
phrases.norwegian: Pusten er en klokke, tikk forsiktig

phrases.english: I hold hope, through ordinary mornings, today.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg holder håp, gjennom vanlige morgener, i dag.

phrases.english: Hope whispers, like coffee steam, in silence.
phrases.norwegian: Håpet hvisker, som kaffedamp, i stillhet.

phrases.english: I water hope, in tiny breaks, between tasks.
phrases.norwegian: Jeg vanner håp, i små pauser, mellom gjøremål.

phrases.english: Some days heal, quietly, when I listen.
phrases.norwegian: Noen dager leges, stille, når jeg lytter.

phrases.english: Hope comes back, like light, after rain.
phrases.norwegian: Håpet kommer tilbake, som lys, etter regn.
